charts.keywords: trend, time-series, line, growth, timeline, progress, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
charts.whenToUse: Data has a time axis; user needs to observe rise/fall trends or rate of change over a continuous period
charts.whenNotToUse: Fewer than 4 data points (use stat card); more than 6 series (visual noise); no time dimension exists
charts.a11yFallback: Visible data table plus concise trend summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores the full range.

charts.keywords: compare, categories, bar, comparison, ranking, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
charts.whenToUse: Comparing discrete categories by magnitude; ranking or ordering is the core insight; categories ≤ 15
charts.whenNotToUse: Categories > 15 (use table or search); data has time dimension (use line); showing proportions (use waffle/stacked)
charts.a11yFallback: Visible sortable data table plus concise comparison summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; focusable headers with Enter/Space sort a

charts.keywords: part-to-whole, pie, donut, percentage, proportion, share, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
charts.whenToUse: ≤5 categories; one dominant segment vs rest; emphasis on visual proportion over exact values
charts.whenNotToUse: Categories > 5; slice differences < 5% (visually indistinguishable); user needs precise values; accessibility-first cont
charts.a11yFallback: Percentage data table and concise part-to-whole summary; offer a stacked bar view. Keyboard: focus reveals slice values; Enter/Space drills

charts.keywords: correlation, distribution, scatter, relationship, pattern, cluster, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart

uxGuidelines.doRule: Use scroll-behavior: smooth on html element
Add padding-top to body equal to nav height
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Let nav overlap first section content

uxGuidelines.doRule: Highlight active nav item with color/underline
uxGuidelines.dontRule: No visual feedback on current location

uxGuidelines.doRule: Use for sites with 3+ levels of depth
Animate 1-2 key elements per view maximum
Use shared motion tokens and test that feedback stays responsive
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Present 150-300ms or any cutoff as a universal requirement
Leave UI frozen with no feedback
Rely only on hover for important actions

uxGuidelines.doRule: Use transform and opacity for animations
Use deceleration when arriving acceleration when leaving and linear for constant-rate progress
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Reject linear easing even for steady rotation or progress

uxGuidelines.doRule: Test all content fits within containers
Account for safe areas and other fixed elements
Understand what creates new stacking context
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Expect z-index to work across contexts

uxGuidelines.doRule: Reserve appropriate space or keep async states in a stable content-driven container
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Insert compact text or media without a layout strategy

uxGuidelines.doRule: Use dvh or account for mobile browser chrome

uxGuidelines.dontRule: Let text span full viewport width

uxGuidelines.doRule: Use 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android; for web use the separate WCAG Target Size rule
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Treat one unit or minimum as universal across platforms

uxGuidelines.doRule: Avoid horizontal swipe on main content
Use for confirmations and important actions
Use a visible focus ring on every interactive control, including modal controls
Change cursor and add subtle visual change
uxGuidelines.dontRule: No hover feedback on clickable elements

uxGuidelines.doRule: Disable button and show loading state
Show clear error messages near problem
Show success message or visual change
Use icons/text in addition to color
Descriptive alt text for meaningful images

uxGuidelines.dontRule: Skip heading levels or misuse for styling

uxGuidelines.doRule: Keep tab order aligned with visual order and test every action without a pointer
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Keyboard traps or illogical tab order

uxGuidelines.doRule: Use semantic HTML and ARIA properly
Use label with for attribute or wrap input
Use aria-live or role=alert for errors
Provide skip to main content link
uxGuidelines.dontRule: No skip link on nav-heavy pages

uxGuidelines.doRule: Lazy load below-fold images and content
Always show label above or beside input
Show a specific error below the input and reference it with aria-describedby
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Show only a top-level error without identifying each invalid field

uxGuidelines.doRule: Validate on blur for most fields
Use email tel number url etc

uxGuidelines.dontRule: Inputs that look like plain text

uxGuidelines.doRule: Start with mobile styles then add breakpoints
Use horizontal scroll or card layout
Use darker text on light backgrounds
Follow platform and component guidance; preserve layout focus and accessible busy status
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Apply one timing threshold to every operation or leave long waits unexplained

uxGuidelines.doRule: Truncate with ellipsis and expand option
Stream text response token by token
Prefer click-to-play; provide pause and captions; stop off-screen and honor reduced motion
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Auto-play high-resolution loops without pause or captions

uxGuidelines.doRule: Honor prefers-reduced-motion and present the final readable state without parallax or scroll-jacking
Offset sticky UI with scroll-padding and dismiss or move persistent overlays
uxGuidelines.dontRule: Let headers footers banners or chat widgets fully cover focus

motion.keywords: hover, button, opacity, lift, press feedback
motion.doRule: Keep displacement under 2px so it reads as feedback not motion
motion.perfNotes: Runs on transform/opacity only so it stays on the compositor thread

motion.keywords: hover, card, scale, tilt, cursor feedback
motion.doRule: Pair with a matching mouseleave tween that reverses the same properties
motion.perfNotes: quickTo() avoids GC churn on lists with 20+ hoverable cards

motion.keywords: hover, magnetic, cursor follow, 3d tilt, removable event listener cleanup
motion.doRule: Clamp the pull strength (e.g. * 0.3) so the element never fully leaves its hit box
motion.perfNotes: Use will-change: transform on the target element for smoother compositing

motion.keywords: scroll, fade in, reveal, on view
motion.doRule: Keep the y offset small (8-16px) so it reads as a fade, not a slide
motion.perfNotes: toggleActions 'play none none reverse' avoids re-triggering on every scroll direction change

motion.keywords: scroll, slide up, staggered section, reveal
motion.doRule: Scope the ScrollTrigger to the section container so it doesn't re-scan the whole page
motion.perfNotes: Set scroller/markers: false in production; markers is dev-only

motion.doRule: Use scrub: true or a small number (0.5-1.5) instead of instant jumps so it feels tied to the scrollbar
motion.perfNotes: Pinning forces layout reflow; test on mid-tier mobile devices, not just desktop

motion.doRule: Keep per-item stagger delay small (0.02-0.04s) for lists longer than 10 items
motion.perfNotes: For virtualized lists, only animate items currently mounted in the DOM

motion.doRule: Combine with from: 'center' for a bento-grid layout to draw the eye inward first
motion.perfNotes: Group DOM writes; avoid interleaving layout reads (getBoundingClientRect) between staggered tweens

motion.keywords: stagger, wave, text reveal, split text
motion.doRule: Revert SplitText on unmount/cleanup (split.revert()) to restore original text nodes for accessibility tools
motion.perfNotes: Splitting text creates one element per character; keep it to headline-length copy only for DOM size

motion.doRule: Preload the destination route's critical assets before the exit tween finishes
motion.perfNotes: Exit animation should always resolve faster than entrance (asymmetric timing) so back/forward feels snappy

motion.doRule: Show a lightweight loading indicator if the destination route's data fetch outlasts the overlay
motion.perfNotes: Prefer CSS transform (yPercent) over top/left to keep the overlay animation on the compositor thread

motion.doRule: Verify the shared element exists in both DOM states before calling Flip.from to avoid a silent no-op
motion.perfNotes: Flip recalculates layout (FLIP technique) so test on low-end devices for jank

motion.doRule: Keep the yPercent delta small (5-15) so foreground and background never desync distractingly
motion.perfNotes: will-change: transform on the parallax layer only; remove it after scroll settles to free GPU memory

motion.doRule: Vary speed per layer (background slowest, foreground fastest) to sell the depth illusion
motion.perfNotes: Batch all layers under one ScrollTrigger container where possible instead of one per layer

motion.keywords: loading, skeleton, shimmer, pulse, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, reduced motion final state
motion.doRule: Use a CSS gradient background-position sweep rather than opacity pulsing; reads as 'loading' more clearly
motion.perfNotes: repeat: -1 tweens are cheap but must be explicitly killed on unmount or they leak in SPA route changes

motion.keywords: progress, spinner, morphing loader, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, timer cleanup, reduced motion final state
motion.doRule: Cap total loop duration under ~1.5s so long waits don't feel like the UI froze on a single beat
motion.perfNotes: Pause the timeline (tl.pause()) when the loading tab/view is not visible to save CPU on background tabs

motion.keywords: carousel, auto-rotate, pause, focus, hover, reduced-motion, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, timer cleanup, final state
motion.doRule: Provide previous/next and play/pause controls; announce the current slide without moving focus
motion.perfNotes: IntersectionObserver stops animation offscreen; visibilitychange stops hidden-tab work; cleanup disconnects the observer

stacks.keywords: react hooks jsx tsx state key memo transition
stacks.doRule: Use stable semantic keys in lists, derive state instead of redundant useEffect sync, and keep clickable controls as native <button> elements
stacks.avoidRule: Array index keys on mutable lists, inline object creation inside hot render loops, clickable <div> without keyboard handlers

stacks.keywords: nextjs next app router rsc server client hydration image link
stacks.doRule: Default to React Server Components, isolate 'use client' to leaf interactive widgets, and provide explicit width/height or aspect-ratio to prevent CLS
stacks.avoidRule: Reading window/localStorage during initial render causing hydration mismatch, unoptimized tags without dimensions

stacks.keywords: vue nuxt composition script setup computed v-for emit
stacks.doRule: Use <script setup>, computed() for derived values, unique :key on v-for, and scoped styles or CSS custom properties
stacks.avoidRule: Mutating props directly, mixing v-if and v-for on the same element, deep watchers where computed suffices

stacks.keywords: svelte sveltekit runes reactive store transition
stacks.doRule: Prefer fine-grained reactive declarations/runes, clean up DOM listeners via action destroy/onDestroy, and respect prefers-reduced-motion in transitions
stacks.avoidRule: Heavy imperative DOM queries when reactive bindings or Svelte actions cleanly express state

stacks.keywords: tailwind utility css theme tokens dark focus-visible
stacks.doRule: Map semantic CSS variables in :root/@theme, pair focus-visible:ring-* on all interactive controls, and keep responsive prefixes mobile-first
stacks.avoidRule: Arbitrary magic-number padding/color proliferation that bypasses design tokens, focus:outline-none without focus-visible ring

stacks.keywords: html css javascript vanilla esm dom web components shadow
stacks.doRule: Use semantic HTML landmarks, :root CSS custom properties, event delegation, and requestAnimationFrame-throttled transform/opacity updates
stacks.avoidRule: Unescaped innerHTML with untrusted data, layout-thrashing offsetTop/getBoundingClientRect reads inside scroll/animation loops
